name: Future AGI
description: Evaluate, observe, and improve LLM and agent applications from one self-hostable platform — tracing, evals, simulations, datasets, guardrails, and a model gateway under Apache 2.0.

skills.name: Evaluation Suite
skills.description: Scores outputs for hallucination, relevance, and task success using configurable evaluators across datasets.

skills.name: Agent Simulations
skills.description: Runs simulated multi-turn conversations against an agent to surface failure paths before real users hit them.

skills.name: Runtime Guardrails
skills.description: Applies input and output checks in production to block unsafe or off-policy responses as they are generated.
